messages.subject: Rashid / Calverton — without prejudice
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

We act for Mr Rashid. Our client is open to a negotiated exit but the current ex-gratia of £45k is not acceptable given the age-discrimination exposure and the s.103A point. Our opening position is £110,000 ex-gratia plus an agreed reference, outplacement and a fee contribution of £2,500. We look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
Deepa Kovac
Birchall Stone LLP
